record.title: An enquiry about the car
record.header_literal: E) CM v CZ (17.12 p.m., November 12th); 17.40; RIZI-36
record.meaning: The message asks where the car is or why it has not arrived. The closing KRAMM is preserved without assigning a biography or a vehicle. The text is an enquiry, not proof that a car was sent.
notes: The source supplies all 36 coordinates and decrypts directly, with no coordinate changes or mask fills.
The nearby D record is a similar but differently framed printed witness. It is not silently substituted for this complete E body.
The interrogative sentence is displayed with a period to reserve ? for unresolved plaintext positions.
